scope: Owned records extracted from a mixed source file. Pointers refer to the exact original revision.

entries.value: Inspect {{TARGET_PACK}}, the active role arrays and the saved reference frames. Produce original enemy replacements in {{DETAIL_TREATMENTS}} using the supported microtile, hybrid and props treatments. Compare four shape vocabularies on the same board: FPV tracked vehicles/quads/radar, Ukrainian patterned beetles and botanical guardians, 1994 robots/comets/glitches, and Coupa-inspired invoices/parcels/linked blocks. Use distinct shapes rather than palette-only variants, and no Z markings in FPV art. Bind exact roles: bouncer to enemy, border-patrol to patrol, lane-boss/staged core to boss, contour-patrol to contour, claimed-rover to rover, eroder to eroder. Keep background, player, objective, supply and wall independent. Classic-only contour, rover, eroder, slowTerrain, lethalTerrain, lifePickup, speedPickup, slowPickup and freezePickup require the Classic scenario format; do not add them to older formats or invent new keys. Keep enemy contact centers/radii and all warning, rejoining, dormant, slow/frozen and pickup-type cues above replacements. Bodies face upward at zero rotation; facing follows observed tick positions, with initial velocity only a fallback. Moving treads/walking track travel while rotors/radar may idle; freeze, stun, dormancy and Pause hold their relevant clocks. Reduced effects keep clear static cues. Target ordinary enemy image boxes of 24–32 CSS pixels on desktop and at least 16 on ordinary phones, capped at 64 logical (boss 40 CSS/80 logical); actorScale remains cosmetic. Measure occupied colored pixels separately: current right-facing procedural poses span 14–16 pixels at a 294-pixel arena in CPU rasterization, not browser/device certification or a promise about arbitrary uploaded art. Keep compact locomotion, small nose ticks and fixed light contact ink independent of reversed theme ink/paper. Where actual core pressure is authored, preserve AIM/CHASE/REST and exact locked-target brackets from the owned classicView projection; freeze holds actor-clock deadlines and reduced effects keep static warnings. Never infer a target or attribute this original pressure extension to Reloaded AI. Keep tails to at most three nearby points within 1.15 cells. Preserve complete simulation definitions, score authority and each turn mode's checkpoint. Validate each changed binding and inspect decoded art plus real playback at actual sizes. Use XPOSED only to compare hierarchy/readability; do not extract its artwork or infer animation timing from stills. Report generated assets, wiring and playback evidence separately.
